_doc: HUMAN-OWNED. Never written by code (read-only input to scripts/readiness_engine.py). One entry per sleeve-VERSION. start_date = first ET session whose returns/trades count as evidence for this version (pre-start data is excluded, so a strategy change resets the track record). end_date (optional) = last session the version traded new entries. status: active | forward_test | exits_only | quarantined (exits_only/quarantined accrue no new evidence => verdict NOT_ELIGIBLE). evidence_basis: daily_returns | trades | both. trial_count = honest number of configurations tried on this idea (DSR deflates at it); never lower it without a recorded reason. Change only with a recorded reason, date and owner.
